**Pull requests are closed.**

This is a hobby project with no support. It was written for one ThinkPad and
shared because it may suit yours. If it doesn't work for you, it doesn't work
for you.

It's MIT licensed, so fork it and do as you like with it. Nothing here needs
to come back.

If you're looking for ThinkPad fan control that is actively maintained and
supports more machines, TPFanControl and its forks have been doing this well
for twenty years:

- https://github.com/Shuzhengz/TPFanCtrl2
- https://github.com/FanDjango/TPFanCtrl2
